## Details

<a id="random_byte"></a>
### [`random_byte`](../../../../src/game/random.asm#L6) `$4AD5`

*routine*

Returns a new random byte in A and in the seed $d9. Mixes the seed with RASTER, $4017 and $4018. The entry carry changes it.
